story.so_far: The case centered on accusations that the brothers manipulated Ethereum's MEV (Maximal Extractable Value) to extract $25 million from the network. MEV refers to the profit miners or validators can make by reordering transactions within a block. Prosecutors alleged the conduct was illegal, while the defense argued it was a legal application of smart contract logic.

timeline.text: The ruling specifically noted that while the conduct may raise ethical questions, it did not involve the false promises required to constitute fraud under current law.
A federal judge ruled the transactions lacked fraudulent terms of use, effectively clearing the brothers of the charges.

articles.title: Bitcoin outpaces gold even as both assets tumble ahead of a likely Fed rate hike

articles.explain: When the Federal Reserve raises interest rates, it generally makes the U.S. dollar stronger and 'riskier' assets like Bitcoin or non-yielding assets like gold less attractive. Higher rates increase the cost of borrowing and provide better returns on safer investments like government bonds, causing investors to shift their capital.

story.title: Global Currency Market Trends
story.so_far: Gold is traditionally seen as a hedge against inflation. However, its value is inversely related to interest rates; as central banks keep rates high, the 'opportunity cost' of holding gold increases because gold doesn't pay interest.

articles.title: Bitwise seeks Texas Stock Exchange listing for Zcash ETF
articles.summary: Bitwise has filed to list a Zcash (ZEC) exchange-traded fund (ETF) on the Texas Stock Exchange.
articles.explain: An ETF is a basket of assets that trades on a stock exchange, just like a stock. A Zcash ETF would track the price of the Zcash cryptocurrency. Investors buy shares in the ETF, and the fund manager (Bitwise) holds the actual Zcash, making it easier for traditional investors to bet on crypto price movements.

story.title: Expansion of Crypto ETFs
story.so_far: In recent years, traditional finance regulators have begun approving ETFs for various cryptocurrencies. These funds allow investors to gain exposure to digital assets without having to manage private keys or set up crypto wallets themselves, bridging traditional market infrastructure with digital assets.

articles.title: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
articles.summary: The Indian rupee closed flat after hitting a seven-month high against the U.S. dollar.
articles.explain: The dollar index tracks the value of the USD against a basket of other major global currencies. When this index rises, it typically weakens the rupee. 'Foreign inflows' refer to money brought into the Indian market by overseas institutional investors, which pushes the rupee higher.

story.title: Indian Rupee Market Performance
story.so_far: The value of the Indian rupee is heavily influenced by inflows of foreign capital into the Indian stock market and the global strength of the U.S. dollar. When global uncertainty rises, investors often sell emerging market currencies to buy U.S. dollars, which are considered a 'safe-haven' currency.

articles.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Should you bet on Coal India’s cash cow despite muted growth?
articles.summary: Analysts are evaluating the upcoming IPO of Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of Coal India, despite concerns regarding profitability growth.
articles.explain: An IPO (Initial Public Offering) is when a company sells shares to the public for the first time. 'Pricing curbs' refer to government-imposed limits on how much a company can charge for its product, which limits the company's ability to maximize profit regardless of market demand.

story.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO Analysis
story.so_far: Coal India is the state-owned coal mining giant of India. Mahanadi Coalfields is one of its most profitable subsidiaries, contributing significantly to the parent company’s bottom line. Investors look at such IPOs for stable dividend income, but they are subject to government-set price caps on coal.

timeline.text: The company is being positioned for an IPO; however, investors are cautioned by pricing regulations and environmental levies that could impact future earnings.

articles.title: Infosys share price: Lost 1/4th investor wealth in 1 year, should you still buy the IT major? Check target, stop loss
articles.summary: Monarch Networth Capital suggests accumulating shares of Infosys following a significant decline in its stock price over the past year.
articles.explain: Accumulating shares is a strategy where an investor buys a stock in increments, rather than all at once, to lower the average purchase price. A 'target price' is an analyst's estimation of what the stock should be worth in the future, while a 'stop loss' is a price level at which an investor would sell to prevent further losses.

story.title: Indian IT Sector Q2 Results
story.so_far: The Indian IT services industry is a pillar of the nation's economy, heavily reliant on export revenue from Western markets. Companies are currently pivoting toward AI-driven service models and managing varying demand for digital transformation projects.

timeline.text: The quarterly reports show a diverging performance across majors like Infosys, TCS, and Wipro amid the broader AI integration phase.

articles.title: SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
articles.summary: SpiceJet’s board has approved a fundraise of up to ₹5,500 crore, causing its stock to surge.
articles.explain: An 'upper circuit' is a regulatory limit set by stock exchanges on how much a stock price can rise in a single day, designed to prevent extreme volatility. Once a stock hits this limit, trading for it is effectively halted for the rest of the day. Fundraising is crucial for distressed firms to stay afloat and resume operations.

story.title: SpiceJet Financial Restructuring
story.so_far: SpiceJet has struggled with high debt and a series of flight cancellations that have impacted its reputation. The airline industry in India is highly capital-intensive, requiring constant cash injections to cover fuel, maintenance, and lease costs.

timeline.text: The airline plans to raise ₹5,500 crore to address operational challenges and repair its financial position, resulting in the stock hitting the 'upper circuit' for six days.
